jsonld_raw.name: (230 G) PUMPKIN SPICE SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.

Pumpkin Spice | An invitation to deep memories. Warm and surprising spices that reveal a delicious sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Notes:
Top notes: Citrus, Nutmeg
Heart notes: Pumpkin.
Base notes: Cinnamon, Spices, Cashmeran, Dry wood

Solid-colored cylindrical container with vertical embossed stripes.
